title: The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton Opens in Hong Kong
summary: Hilton today announced the grand opening of The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, marking the brand's debut in Hong Kong.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


- **Tapestry Collection by Hilton debuts in Hong Kong with the opening of The Lan Kwai Fong, marking the brand's first hotel in the city.**
- **Located at 2 Arbuthnot Road in the heart of Central, the hotel blends the artistic serenity of Tai Kwun with the vibrant energy of Lan Kwai Fong as an "urban private mansion."**
- **The 41-room hotel features three distinct room designs and the Heaven and Earth dining destination, pairing modern Sichuan gastronomy with a vintage-inspired cocktail bar.**


**HONG KONG –**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/?msockid=0929d8118ab66f391ba3cdb68bdf6eff) (Nasdaq: HLT) today announced the grand opening of[The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hkgupup-the-lan-kwai-fong/) , marking the brand's debut in Hong Kong. Located at 2 Arbuthnot Road, Central, the hotel draws inspiration from the contrasting character of its surroundings, bringing together the artistic heritage of the Tai Kwun district and the vibrant energy of Lan Kwai Fong. Through its distinctive design, curated art, and considered food and beverage experiences, the hotel offers guests a unique perspective on one of Hong Kong’s most dynamic neighborhoods.


Situated in the heart of Central, directly opposite the Tai Kwun arts compound, the hotel is within walking distance of Lan Kwai Fong and Soho, with easy access to The Landmark and Central MTR Station. Here, historic stone steps, art institutions, Michelin-starred restaurants and high-end retail sit alongside one another, creating one of Hong Kong's most layered urban neighborhoods. The Lan Kwai Fong sits at the very heart of it all – offering a considered retreat surrounded by arts and culture by day, and a natural extension of Lan Kwai Fong's vibrant pulse by night. Guests can move seamlessly between two distinct urban rhythms, discovering the many sides of Central along the way.


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Exterior


Alex Shockley, senior director, Lifestyle & Collection Brands, Asia Pacific, Hilton, said, "Hong Kong is a city that is always buzzing with energy, and we are thrilled to bring the Tapestry Collection by Hilton brand here. The Lan Kwai Fong perfectly embodies the essence of Tapestry – each hotel is uniquely distinctive, deeply connected to the culture and pulse of its location. From the art-inspired façade to its curated dining experiences, this hotel brings together the vibrant character of Central in a way that invites guests to discover the neighborhood from a new perspective."


Benny Lee, vice president, Operations, East China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, Hilton Greater China & Mongolia, Hilton, said, "Hong Kong has always been one of the most representative markets for Hilton. The opening of The Lan Kwai Fong not only brings the first Tapestry Collection hotel to the city, but also further enriches our brand portfolio in Hong Kong. From business travel to lifestyle experiences, Hilton is responding to the needs of the Hong Kong market with an ever more diverse offering."


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Lobby


The experience begins the moment guests arrive. The hotel's façade features a programmable dynamic lighting system that blends softly into the surrounding streetscape by day and transforms into a flowing, ever-shifting visual rhythm by night, echoing the contrasting urban pulse of Central around the clock. Beyond the entrance, art curation throughout the lobby adds further depth to the space, inviting guests to feel the interplay of art and design as they move through it.


-


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Twin Guest Room High Floor


-


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - King Guest Room


Wilson Ho, general manager, The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, said, “We want this hotel to feel like a private mansion in Central, one that allows guests to truly experience the unique charm of Hong Kong’s most dynamic district. From here, guests can immerse themselves in the city’s energy and cultural vibrancy, while also finding a space of ease amid the bustle. We look forward to bringing Central’s diverse character to every guest, inviting them to explore the city’s most authentic rhythms in their own way.”


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - King Lan Kwai Fong Suite


Forty-one guest rooms are presented in three distinct design styles, reflecting the hotel's individual and multifaceted character. The LKF Suite, themed modern glamour, blends metropolitan style with artistic personality, pairing deep-toned screens with a red velvet chaise lounge and marble details to create a distinctive sense of style. Deluxe rooms are anchored in warm elegance, where warm wood tones are complemented by soft, flowing lines and brightly accented furniture, creating a cozy, intimate atmosphere. Twin rooms showcase contemporary chic, combining geometric motifs with a playful spatial layout and modern art touches.


-


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Restaurant Heaven and Earth (Earth)


-


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton - Restaurant Heaven and Earth (Heaven)


The hotel's dining destination, Heaven and Earth, unfolds as a dialogue between the two. Earth presents Modern Sichuan gastronomy, reinterpreting traditional Sichuan culinary philosophy with an emphasis on depth of flavour, heat and the interplay of ingredients. The signature Mapo Tofu infuses classic spicy-savoury notes with slow-braised Wagyu beef tendon and fish maw, presenting a familiar taste in an entirely new dimension. Heaven, the bar, pays homage to classic cocktail traditions, drawing directly on the craft of late-17th- to late-19th-century mixology to revive a timeless balance and elegance, and its design details are equally captivating — a vintage-style bar counter paired with an elegant ceiling mural, complementing each other to add an extraordinary touch to moments of leisure. Together, the restaurant and bar offer two distinct experiences that reflect the hotel's own character and approach to bringing people together.


With the opening of The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton, the brand joins Conrad Hotels & Resorts, Motto by Hilton and Hilton Garden Inn​ in Hong Kong, forming a diversified portfolio across the city.


The Lan Kwai Fong, Tapestry Collection by Hilton is part of Hilton Honors, the award-winning guest loyalty program of Hilton. Hilton Honors members can book directly through official Hilton channels to enjoy instant benefits, including flexible payment options with Points & Money, member-exclusive discounts, free high-speed Wi-Fi, and the use of digital room keys through the industry-leading Hilton Honors app, with opportunities to receive exclusive Hilton Honors experiences. The hotel is located at 2 Arbuthnot Road, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong. For more information or room reservations, please visit[hotel website](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hkgupup-the-lan-kwai-fong/) or contact the hotel atHKGUP_SM@hilton.com .
